 Record warmth, then rainy and turning colder this weekend 
 Your First Alert Weather Forecast: 
 The record high for November 20 is 62 degrees. By Andy Meade Published : Nov. 20, 2026 at 6:29 AM CST | Updated : 16 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google Record warmth is possible today. Wisconsin’s statewide gun-deer hunting season opens tomorrow, with warm and windy weather in the forecast. Hunters should be mindful of high fire danger. Rain is in the forecast later this weekend, followed by a much colder start to next week.
 TODAY: Sunshine mixes with high clouds as highs climb into the low-to-mid 60s. Green Bay’s record of 62° could be broken.
 WEEKEND: Saturday stays warm and windy, with highs in the mid-60s. Gusty winds and dry soils bring high fire danger . A few spotty showers may help ease conditions in parts of the Northwoods early Saturday morning, but coverage will be limited.
 Better rain chances arrive late Saturday, especially northwest of the Fox Valley. Rain is likely Sunday morning more widespread, followed by falling temperatures through the day starting in the 50’s with 30’s by the evening. 
 NEXT WEEK: Much colder Monday and Tuesday, with highs in the 30s. A light, spotty rain-snow mix is possible Wednesday but remains limited in coverage; Thanksgiving looks mostly sunny with highs in the low 40s. Holiday travelers should check back for updates as the forecast remains uncertain.
 Check it out, your favorite weather graphics are in our First Alert Map Room. You can find that here: First Alert Map Room .
 You can always keep our forecast handy with our free weather app. Look for the WBAY First Alert Weather App in the Apple app store and Google Play.
 WIND FORECAST
 TODAY: S 5-10 MPH, GUSTS TO 20 MPH
 SATURDAY: S/SW 10-20 MPH, GUSTS TO 30 MPH
 LOCAL WEATHER THIS WEEK
 TODAY: Sunshine mixed with high clouds. Record warmth possible. HIGH: 65
 TONIGHT: Fair and mild. Breezy at times. LOW: 53
 SATURDAY: Clouds thicken. Windy and warm again. Late rain, especially NORTHWEST of the Fox Valley. HIGH: 64 LOW: 48
 SUNDAY: Morning rain likely, then some clearing. Turning breezy, with falling afternoon temperatures. HIGH: 51 LOW: 28
 MONDAY: A few flakes NORTH. Partly sunny. Colder, but less wind. HIGH: 38 LOW: 20
 TUESDAY: A mix of sun and clouds. Cold, but calm. HIGH: 36 LOW: 22
 WEDNESDAY: Cloudy skies. A spotty light mix? HIGH: 40 LOW: 25
 THANKSGIVING: Mostly sunny. Seasonably cool. HIGH: 42
